about: General category list for regional bundles (decision 213, plan 138): input of `qgen taxonomy --bundle <id>`, which adds the region's own categories and proposes subcategories; a category may be left out for a region with too little to ask. Authoring only, never read by app/. `slug`: the category's key in every regional bundle (decision 259); `name`: its English name, {region} = the region's English name; the name in the bundle's language comes with the proposal, es/de names are drafted on `--apply`; slugs and names repeat across bundles (decision 110 (d)). Everywhere excluded (D-49): what families anywhere answer without a connection to the region, whatever their language, and world topics: they stay in base.

categories.name: Geography of {region}
categories.scope: Provinces/departments, cities and towns, rivers, mountains, coasts, islands, landmarks and monuments, roads and distances.
categories.excludes: Country-level facts known worldwide (base Capital cities, Countries, Famous landmarks).

categories.name: Nature of {region}
categories.scope: Native animals and plants, national parks and reserves, ecosystems, climate and seasons, natural phenomena.
categories.excludes: Animals and plants known worldwide without a regional angle (base Animals, Plants, Amazon).

categories.name: History of {region}
categories.scope: Indigenous peoples before the conquest, colony, independence, wars and founding figures, 19th–20th century, presidents and turning points.
categories.excludes: World history (base History); current party politics.

categories.name: People of {region}
categories.scope: Well-known people not covered by music, sport, arts or TV: scientists, inventors, business founders, heroes of daily life, popular characters.
categories.excludes: Names known worldwide (base); musicians, athletes, writers, actors go to their categories.

categories.name: Food and drink of {region}
categories.scope: Typical dishes, sweets and desserts, drinks, fruits and ingredients, regional variants, markets and street food.
categories.excludes: International food (base Food and drink, World cuisines: a dish known worldwide by name, coffee in general).

categories.name: Festivals and traditions of {region}
categories.scope: Festivals, carnivals, fairs, holidays, family customs, crafts, traditional dress and games.
categories.excludes: World festivals and customs (base Holidays and traditions, Traditional dress).

categories.name: Myths and legends of {region}
categories.scope: Legendary creatures, ghost stories, popular beliefs and superstitions, indigenous myths.
categories.excludes: World mythologies and generic superstitions (base Myths and legends, Legends and superstitions).

categories.name: Music and dance of {region}
categories.scope: Rhythms and dances, instruments, singers and bands, famous songs, music festivals.
categories.excludes: World music and global stars by name only (base Music).

categories.name: Art and literature of {region}
categories.scope: Writers and books, poets, painters and sculptors, architecture, museums, comics.
categories.excludes: World literature and art (base Art and literature; García Márquez basics).

categories.name: Film and television of {region}
categories.scope: Telenovelas, series, films, presenters, actors, radio, cartoons, internet celebrities.
categories.excludes: International film and TV (base Film, TV and superheroes).

categories.name: Sport in {region}
categories.scope: National teams, clubs, athletes, Olympic medals, the region's favourite sports, traditional games and sports.
categories.excludes: World football and sport (base Football, Sports).

categories.name: How {region} speaks
categories.scope: Words and slang, sayings and expressions, accents, loanwords from indigenous languages, the region's own languages and dialects.
categories.excludes: The region's language in general (base Languages and words, Proverbs of the world).

categories.name: Daily life in {region}
categories.scope: Money and banknotes, brands and products, shops, transport, school, home, everyday objects and habits, public services.
categories.excludes: World brands and money (base Brands and logos, Money and currencies).

categories.name: Symbols of {region}
categories.scope: Flag, anthem, coat of arms, national symbols (bird, tree, flower), emblems of the provinces/cities.
categories.excludes: The flag as recognised worldwide (base Flags).
